answer: A place I have long dreamed of visiting is Switzerland, particularly the Alpine region. I first became [[captivated]] by it through photographs and documentaries, which made the scenery look almost unreal, and more recently through my job, because I work at an education consultancy and a few of our students have gone there to study hospitality. When they send photos back, I must admit I feel a little envious. The idea of snow-capped mountains, crystal-clear lakes and charming villages is incredibly [[appealing]] to me, especially as someone who has never actually seen snow. If I ever go, I would love to take the scenic train routes that wind through the mountains, which are said to be breathtaking. I would also like to go hiking beside one of the lakes and perhaps visit a small village where cheese is still made in the traditional way. I imagine the air there is wonderfully fresh, [[a world away from]] the dust and traffic I am used to. What draws me most is the promise of such [[pristine]] natural beauty, which is increasingly rare. I would also love to experience the local culture and food, of course. Honestly, it is at the very top of my [[bucket list]], and I am determined to get there one day, even though it is famously expensive. I think some places are worth saving up for, and this is definitely one of them, so I have quietly started putting a little money aside each month.

followUps.q: Would you prefer to go alone or with others?
followUps.answer: With others, ideally my family or a couple of close friends. Beautiful places are more enjoyable when you can share them, and I think my parents would be amazed to see snow for the first time.

followUps.q: How long would you like to stay there?
followUps.answer: At least two weeks, if I could afford it. I would not want to rush from one place to another; I would rather travel slowly and actually enjoy each place properly.

note: Added how he knows it through consultancy students, specific plans (trains, lakes, village), saving up; plain mark 'fresh' replaced by 'a world away from'; added 'bucket list'.
